title: Experiment metric fingerprints: computation and call sites
answers: How are experiment metric fingerprints computed?
What fields change a metric fingerprint?
body:
- `products/experiments/backend/hogql_queries/experiment_metric_fingerprint.py:compute_metric_fingerprint` hashes sorted-key JSON of the metric dict, UTC start_date, stats method, and optional exposure_criteria / only_count_matured_users / excluded_variants.
- `METRIC_FIELDS_TO_IGNORE` (uuid, name, kind, fingerprint, only_count_matured_users) is stripped from the metric dict, so renames or uuid changes don't alter the fingerprint.
- `_strip_empty_breakdowns` makes an empty breakdownFilter hash like none (saved-metric merge path vs raw path would otherwise differ).
- `temporal/recalc_fingerprint.py:compute_recalc_fingerprint` = sha256(config_fp + "recalculation"), keeping recalc rows separate from daily timeseries rows in the shared `ExperimentMetricResult` table.
- Call sites: `presentation/serializers.py` (stamps fingerprints), `ExperimentService._recompute_fingerprints`, daily discovery activities in `posthog/temporal/experiments/activities.py`, `recalculation.py:_recalc_fingerprints_for_run`, `timeseries_sync.py:sync_timeseries_recalculation`.
- Hazard: read paths recompute from current experiment fields, so changing start_date/exposure_criteria/stats config/etc. orphans old rows.
applies: When adding or changing an input to the fingerprint; every call site must pass it consistently.
